knowledge.name: Synthetic facility emissions inventory
knowledge.detail: Fixed facility records contain Scope 1, 2, and 3 figures, baselines, targets, thresholds, locations, and asset types.

knowledge.name: Screening rules and evidence controls
knowledge.detail: Bundled rules define calculations, routing, synthetic labels, missing-record behavior, and prohibited compliance claims.

knowledge.name: Synthetic offset candidate catalog
knowledge.detail: Fixed project types, credit volumes, prices, vintages, and named programs support a due-diligence shortlist only.

knowledge.name: Approved production data seams
knowledge.detail: Verified emissions, environmental management, and approved registry connections are documented but not enabled.

intelligence_processing.name: Scope inventory consolidation
intelligence_processing.detail: Aggregates synthetic facility Scope 1, 2, and 3 figures into facility and portfolio views with evidence limitations.

intelligence_processing.name: Non-legal threshold screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares recorded Scope 1 figures with synthetic thresholds and targets without declaring regulatory compliance.

intelligence_processing.name: Reduction scenario analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates target gaps and compares synthetic reduction actions, estimated tonnes, and costs for multidisciplinary review.

intelligence_processing.name: Offset due-diligence analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares a synthetic emissions gap with candidate credit volume and cost without purchase, retirement, or claim.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable RAPP Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The credential-free single-file agent exposes four read-only operations through local Brainstem chat and API routes.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two knowledge files support persona-led preview flows while the validated agent remains unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Responses lead with synthetic results, explain limitations, name required reviewers, and end with the no-write boundary.

management_reporting.name: Emissions inventory review
management_reporting.detail: Shows facility and portfolio scope totals while stating that the synthetic inventory is not verified emissions evidence.

management_reporting.name: Threshold and target screening
management_reporting.detail: Reports threshold position and reduction progress as reviewable screening, not a legal compliance determination.

management_reporting.name: Reduction scenario review pack
management_reporting.detail: Presents target gaps, candidate actions, estimated reductions, and costs for engineering, finance, and leadership review.

management_reporting.name: Offset due-diligence shortlist
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes candidate projects, volumes, prices, and named programs without validating, buying, retiring, or claiming credits.

tools.name: EmissionTrackingAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent provides four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated draft pilot with four skills and two knowledge files; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill results.

tools.name: Verified emissions data platform
tools.detail: Approved production seam for source-backed inventory data; the current package has no live connection.

tools.name: Environmental management system
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed environmental records and workflows; no read or write integration is enabled.

tools.name: Approved carbon registry connector
tools.detail: Future authenticated seam for registry evidence; purchases, retirements, disclosures, and claims remain outside the agent.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: All organizations, measurements, statuses, costs, and recommendations are fictional pilot evidence, not production facts.

supporting_features.name: Four independently routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Dashboard, compliance screening, reduction planning, and offset analysis remain independently callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown facility identifiers return no substituted records, and the agent does not browse or invent missing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Human approval and authorization gates
supporting_features.detail: Qualified sustainability, regulatory, engineering, finance, environmental, and executive reviewers retain decisions.

supporting_features.name: Read-only action boundary
supporting_features.detail: No filing, attestation, credit transaction, disclosure, operational action, or external-system write is performed.

supporting_features.name: Validated evidence anchors
supporting_features.detail: Four strict-isolation Brainstem captures and four Copilot Studio preview cases passed against locked synthetic anchors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: The Copilot Studio pilot remains Draft and unpublished; validation and push do not authorize publication.
